## What's new

- **Works on networks that block GitHub.** r2backup now checks for updates and
  downloads them from its own site, [r2backup.pages.dev](https://r2backup.pages.dev),
  and only asks GitHub if the site can't be reached. Signing in goes through
  the same address. So on a school or office network that blocks GitHub, you
  can still update and sign in. The installer, **r2backup-setup.exe**, finds
  the newest version the same way.
- **A home page.** [r2backup.pages.dev](https://r2backup.pages.dev) has the
  downloads, the install commands and these release notes in one place. The
  one-line install commands now download from there too.

## Heads up

- This update itself still comes from GitHub, because the version you have
  now asks GitHub. If GitHub is blocked where you are, download
  **r2backup-setup.exe** from [r2backup.pages.dev](https://r2backup.pages.dev)
  and run it once. Updates after that come from the site.
